title: Getting Started with ROvis.table
text: ro_dt_table() wraps DT::datatable() accessible defaults (ARIA-labelled pagination, sensible page length). Pair ro_dt_theme() Shiny UI consistent styling: Shiny app, add ro_dt_theme() alongside DTOutput():
code: ro_dt_table(   data = head(mtcars, 20),   caption = "Motor Trend car road tests",   sorting = TRUE,   pagelength = 10 ) library(shiny)  ui <- fluidPage(   ro_dt_theme(sorting = TRUE),   DT::DTOutput("mytable") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$mytable <- DT::renderDT(     ro_dt_table(mtcars, caption = "Motor Trend car road tests", sorting = TRUE)   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)
